oss_reference.practice: Smagorinsky-type single-coefficient (scalar) SGS viscosity driven by a |c_n c_m| absolute-value proxy Q of the non-equilibrium stress magnitude, with the local relaxation time tau = 0.5*(tau0 + sqrt(tau0^2 + 6*Q*Sc/rho)) and Sc = 0.17
source_of_truth: LatFlow/Domain.py:118-128 (CollideSC les branch: Q, tau, collision)
oss_reference.note: les_train.py (the only upstream driver that switches les=True) is not runnable as shipped: TensorFlow 1.x + cv2.cv API, and it references undefined names (lr, total_loss) at lines ~186-189. The cross-validated artefact is therefore the closure in LatFlow/Domain.py, not an upstream trajectory.

decision: Decide whether TensorLBM should (a) transplant the upstream |c_n c_m| proxy Q as its non-equilibrium-stress SGS closure, (b) keep its own signed-stress Frobenius-norm closure and publish a coefficient conversion so upstream settings (Sc=0.17) can be reproduced, or (c) accept the proxy as an equal alternative behind a switch. The decision is taken by the predeclared KPI table below and committed in docs/XVAL-LBM-LES-SCALAR-Q-ABS-CC-PROXY.md.

alternatives.A: in-house tensorlbm.turbulence.collide_smagorinsky_bgk: nu_t = C_s^2 * |S|_F with |S|_F reconstructed from the Frobenius norm of the SIGNED non-equilibrium stress Pi_ij = sum_q c_qi c_qj (f_q - f_q^eq); tau_eff = 0.5*(tau0 + sqrt(tau0^2 + 18 C_s^2 |Pi|_F/rho)); nominal C_s = 0.1
alternatives.B: faithful torch port of upstream CollideSC(les=True): Q = sqrt(2 sum_q (f_q-f_q^eq)^2 EEk_q), EEk_q = sum_{n,m}|c_qn c_qm| = (sum_n |c_qn|)^2; tau_eff = 0.5*(tau0 + sqrt(tau0^2 + 6 Q Sc/rho)); Sc = 0.17
alternatives.A_map: arm A evaluated at the coefficient-mapped value C_s^map = sqrt(Sc * kbar / 3), kbar = mean(Q/|Pi|_F) measured on the same configuration, i.e. the single-scalar conversion that option (b) would publish

hypothesis.H1: Q/|Pi|_F is a topology-independent constant to within 15%, therefore a single scalar conversion C_s = sqrt(Sc*kbar/3) reproduces the upstream closure to within the owner 15% band on identical fields and on the resulting Taylor-Green trajectory (option b is sufficient; no code change to the closure itself).
hypothesis.H0_falsifier: the ratio Q/|Pi|_F spreads by more than 15% over strain topologies (pure shear / pure strain / solid-body rotation / axisymmetric strain) or over real LBM states, OR the mapped arm deviates from arm B by more than 15% in nu_t or in the Taylor-Green decay rate; then the |c_n c_m| proxy is not a single-constant estimator of the strain-rate magnitude and must NOT be transplanted (decision: keep the Frobenius closure, report the bias band, offer the conversion only as guidance).
hypothesis.H2_side: both closures are asymptotically safe: they reduce to BGK exactly as the non-equilibrium stress vanishes (solid-body rotation gives Pi^neq = 0 -> nu_t = 0 for both), and neither degrades a well-resolved laminar run by more than 3% in the decay rate.

reference_values.R1_chapman_enskog_identity: for the exactly constructed first-order non-equilibrium field f = f^eq + f^(1), f^(1)_q = -3 tau0 w_q rho c_qi c_qj S_ij (trace-free S), the non-equilibrium stress is EXACTLY Pi_ij = -2 rho c_s^2 tau0 S_ij with c_s^2 = 1/3, hence |Pi|_F = (2/3) rho tau0 |S|_F and nu_t = c_s^2 (tau_eff - tau0) = C_s^2 |S|_F (closed form)
reference_values.R2_smagorinsky_law: nu_t = (C_s Delta)^2 sqrt(2 S_ij S_ij) with Delta = 1 (standard Lily/Smagorinsky definition)
reference_values.R3_taylor_green_decay: 2D Taylor-Green (exact Navier-Stokes): K(t) = (U0^2/4) exp(-4 nu k^2 t), k = 2 pi/L, so a measured decay rate gamma implies an effective viscosity nu_eff = gamma/(4 k^2)
reference_values.R4_closure_consistency: if the closure adds a viscosity nu_t, then the decay rate measured over a window must equal 4 k^2 (nu0 + mean nu_t) over that same window (a-posteriori identity, no tuning)

metrics.pi_identity_rel_pct: | |Pi|_F(numeric from arm A) - (2/3) rho tau0 |S|_F (closed form R1) | / closed form, per strain topology (percent)
metrics.q_proxy_rel_pct: same comparison for the upstream proxy Q against the same closed form R1 (percent)
metrics.k_ratio: Q / |Pi|_F per strain topology and per sampled LBM state (dimensionless)
metrics.k_spread_pct: 100 * (max_t k_ratio - min_t k_ratio) / mean_t k_ratio over the predeclared topology set
metrics.nu_t_nominal_rel_pct: |nu_t(A, C_s=0.1) - nu_t(B, Sc=0.17)| / nu_t(B) on identical fields (nominal coefficients; expected to be large, reported for orientation only)
metrics.nu_t_mapped_rel_pct: |nu_t(A_map) - nu_t(B)| / nu_t(B) on identical fields -- PRIMARY adoption KPI
metrics.gamma_K_cross_rel_pct: |gamma_K(A_map) - gamma_K(B)| / gamma_K(B) from the Taylor-Green decay fit -- PRIMARY solver-level KPI
metrics.gamma_K_les_gain_pct: 100 * (gamma_K(LES arm) - gamma_K(BGK)) / gamma_K(BGK); the closure must only ADD dissipation, so this must be > 0
metrics.nu_eff_consistency_pct: |gamma_fit/(4 k^2) - (nu0 + mean nu_t applied in the fit window)| / (nu0 + mean nu_t) (R4)
metrics.apriori_rel_pct: |mean applied nu_t - C_s,eff^2 * <|S|_F from the analytic Taylor-Green field>| / mean applied nu_t: a-priori vs a-posteriori
metrics.multimode_K_rel_pct: |K_final(A_map) - K_final(B)| / K_final(B) on the multi-mode (nonlinear, under-resolved) initial condition

baseline_control.baseline: arm A at nominal C_s = 0.1 (the shipped in-house default) and arm B at the upstream default Sc = 0.17; both are pre-existing defaults, neither is tuned here
baseline_control.control: BGK (collide_bgk, zero eddy viscosity) at the identical configuration: it isolates the SGS contribution from the discretisation and gives the gamma_K_les_gain reference
baseline_control.reference: closed forms R1/R2/R3/R4 (Chapman-Enskog identity, Smagorinsky law, exact Taylor-Green decay) -- not another solver, so every accuracy statement is independent of any implementation
baseline_control.unit_of_analysis: one solver arm at one (case, n, Re, C_s/Sc) configuration; each KPI is a scalar per arm-configuration

predeclared_thresholds.identity_note: the exact-CE synthetic field is analytic; 1e-4 absorbs the float32 lattice-velocity cast inside the in-house norm helper, not a modelling error
predeclared_thresholds.port_note: arm B with Sc = 0 must reproduce the shipped collide_bgk to round-off; failure means the port is not the upstream operator and no conclusion may be drawn from it
predeclared_thresholds.proxy_consistency_note: H1 is accepted only if k_spread_pct <= 15% AND nu_t_mapped_rel_pct <= 15% AND gamma_K_cross_rel_pct <= 15% on every predeclared configuration
predeclared_thresholds.les_gain_rule: an LES arm is considered active iff gamma_K_les_gain_pct > 0 and the applied nu_t is non-zero; a closure that never changes the trajectory is reported as a no-op, not as agreement
predeclared_thresholds.stability_rule: a run containing a non-finite population, or |u| > 10 U0, or rho outside [0.5, 1.5], is declared FAILED and reported; no re-tuning of tau, C_s, Sc, u0 or step count afterwards
predeclared_thresholds.convergence_rule: a KPI is grid-converged when |KPI(n=64) - KPI(n=32)| / |KPI(n=64)| < 15%

cases.name: tg4_n64_re1000
cases.kind: multi-mode (4 modes, nonlinear, under-resolved) periodic box

sensitivity_points: grid resolution n in {32, 64} at Re = 1000, U0 = 0.05 (discretisation of the non-equilibrium stress)
molecular relaxation time tau0 in {0.548 (Re=100), 0.5048 (Re=1000, n=32)} i.e. a resolved laminar regime and a near-stability-limit regime (omega -> 2)
strain topology of the exact-CE synthetic field in {pure shear, pure strain, solid-body rotation, axisymmetric strain}, each at |S|_F = 0.005 / 0.02 / 0.05 (amplitude sweep of the SGS law)
variables_changed: SGS closure (signed Frobenius norm vs |c_n c_m| proxy vs BGK off)
variables_controlled: D2Q9 BGK collision kernel and streaming (tensorlbm.solver.collide_bgk / stream)
f = f^eq(rho, u) initialisation on cell centres x_i = i + 0.5
torch float64, fixed thread count, CPU
confounders: upstream is TensorFlow 1.x float32 on GPU and ships no runnable LES driver; the comparison is formulation-level (same closure algebra evaluated on identical float64 torch states), not bit-level against upstream binaries

upstream stores rho and u from the previous stream step and re-uses them in the collision; the port recomputes both from f at the collision instant -- the two are equivalent inside upstream's own Solve loop (stream then collide), but the port cannot inherit any upstream statefulness bug

single-mode Taylor-Green carries no sub-grid content: LES activity there is driven by the discretisation defect (non-equilibrium stress), so the decay tests measure the closure LAW and its transport, not turbulence-model quality; the 4-mode case is the only nonlinear one and is reported as cross-solver agreement, not against an analytic solution

the in-house relaxation cap (nu_t <= 1/6 via tau_eff <= tau + 0.5) has no upstream counterpart: at the operating points here it never activates, but a strongly under-resolved case would diverge between the arms for reasons unrelated to the closure algebra
repetition_rationale: both arms are deterministic (zero run-to-run variance), so repetition is replaced by (a) 4 predeclared cases, (b) 3 sensitivity axes (n, tau0, strain topology x amplitude), (c) three independent checks per closure: exact-CE identity, field-level nu_t agreement, trajectory-level decay agreement. No stochastic seeds are involved except a fixed-sign multi-mode phase choice.
